macros.name: cluefont
macros.doc: The clues are typeset using the \cluefont font.

macros.name: sudpuzznewline
macros.doc: \sudpuzznewline provides a \newline macro for use in a comment being written to a puzzle file.

macros.name: writepuzzle
macros.doc: \writepuzzle takes nine arguments — the nine lines specifying a puzzle — and writes them to the \puzzlefile file.
